tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Build CIF Library
tool.description: build a reusable mini or augmented candidate library
tool.command: touch '$library_archive' '$library_manifest' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$library_archive' '$library_manifest' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p cif_inputs archive_inputs library_output && python -m zipfile -e '$cif_archive' archive_inputs && find archive_inputs -type f -iname '*.cif' -exec cp -n {} cif_inputs/ \; && #if str($library_mode) == 'augmented' python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_runner.py build-library \ --cif-dir cif_inputs \ --library-mode '$library_mode' \ --radiation '$radiation' \ --base-db-root "\${RADAR_PD_DB_ROOT}/database_${radiation}" \ --output-root library_output \ --manifest-output '$library_manifest' \ --archive '$library_archive' $overwrite \ > >(tee -a '$console_output') 2> >(tee -a '$console_output' >&2) #else python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_runner.py build-library \ --cif-dir cif_inputs \ --library-mode '$library_mode' \ --radiation '$radiation' \ --output-root library_output \ --manifest-output '$library_manifest' \ --archive '$library_archive' $overwrite \ > >(tee -a '$console_output') 2> >(tee -a '$console_output' >&2) #end if

param.name: cif_archive
param.label: Prepared CIF source bundle
param.help: A ZIP containing one or more CIF files. RADAR-PD Interactive prepares this bundle automatically from loose CIFs, ZIP archives, and reusable Galaxy CIF datasets.

tool.help: Builds a portable RADAR-PD library from one prepared ZIP bundle. Use RADAR-PD Interactive to combine loose CIF files, one or more ZIP archives, and reusable Galaxy CIF datasets into this bundle. "Only my CIFs" creates a compact standalone library. "Built-in + my CIFs" augments the matching read-only MP/COD catalog. The resulting ZIP is preserved in Galaxy History and can be selected as the candidate library in RADAR-PD Analyze.
